frontMatter.title: Thursday Club Night + Grade 3 Ladies: Navan 'B' vs Ardee
frontMatter.summary: Thursday Club Night: two courts from 9pm, an extra 30 minutes of play, and a Grade 3 Ladies clash as Navan 'B' take on Ardee.

prev.title: This Wednesday: Claremont Stadium Club Night
prev.summary: Two big Grade 6 Mixed fixtures at Claremont this Wednesday: Navan A in a must-win league match vs Ardee, and Navan B in a knockout cup tie vs Athboy/Kells. Members’ courts open from 8:30pm.

next.title: Weekly Badminton Round-Up: Cup Semi-Final Secured & Big League Matches Ahead
next.summary: A busy week of badminton with hard-fought draws, a Cup win on points for our Grade 6 Mens to reach the Semi-Final, and key league fixtures coming up. Note: No club night on Wednesday 4th March—adult club nights are Monday 2nd and Thursday 5th.
